# Agentix Marketing

> Agentix Marketing is a specialist Shopify development and SEO agency helping ecommerce brands design, build, and grow high-converting online stores. Based in the US, serving brands globally.

## What we do

- Custom Shopify store development, theme design, and Shopify Plus enterprise solutions
- Platform migrations to Shopify (WooCommerce, Magento, BigCommerce)
- B2B and wholesale Shopify solutions
- SEO strategy, technical SEO, on-page SEO, and AI-era search optimization
- Conversion rate optimization (CRO) and performance analytics
- Email marketing and retention
- Custom Shopify app development and API integrations
